name: Himiko
source:
"This is the beginning of our world conquest!"

Based on Himiko, who was a shaman queen of Yamataikoku in ancient Wa (Japan).

A hero of Yamatai, seeking to unite the world for the sake of peace. Her ambitions are high, but her strength and wisdom are not and so she lives a life of failure.

She has a habit of speaking everything the moment she thinks it. Because of that, perhaps, she is very charismatic. She calls the [url=/c5167]main character[/url], who saved her in time of crisis, "Big Brother".

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char01a]English official site[/url]]
